cohort: 23 singleton spontaneous pregnancies in 17 women diagnosed with mastocytosis
finding: Pregnancy in women with well-controlled mastocytosis did not significantly worsen disease-related symptoms and resulted in generally favorable pregnancy and delivery outcomes.
mod_finding: Of the five cesarean deliveries, four were due to obstetrical indications and one was due to mastocytosis, with no anesthesia-related complications reported.
